text:
anya: Bagel emergency! Someone toasted a triple-seeded on high and it went nuclear in the toaster. Crumbs everywhere and my sesame seeds are haunting my keyboard. :exploding_head:
derek: Sorry — that was me. I swear I set it to 2 slices but hit 'bagel' mode. I'll clean the crumbs. Also, can we agree toaster rules? No bagel on high, and always use the crumb tray.
sophie: Seconding. Also can we stop using the toaster slot as a plate? I found a half-eaten bagel on top this morning. Gross. :nauseated_face: 
ops-bot: Facilities note: toaster crumb tray cleaned at 08:47 by facilities. If toaster mode needs locking, submit ticket with reason. (automated)
anya: Thank you ops! Small suggestion: "Bagel Brigade" rota to buy bagels Mondays and clean toaster Fridays. Volunteers?
derek: I'll take Monday rotation for April 7.
sophie: I'll sign up for Friday crumb duty. Also proposing a tiny sticker on the toaster: "Bagel mode = low, use tray". Clear and visible.
pantry-bot: Suggestion recorded: "toaster sticker + crumb brush". Poll: buy crumb brush and toaster sticker? React :+1: to approve.
anya: Also plea: label your cream cheese tubs. I grabbed someone's truffle chive by mistake and nearly swooned. Delicious but awkward.
derek: Ha — my bad, that was mine. Will label. And for the record, truffle chive is community-approved. :clap: 
sophie: Tiny rule: if you open a fresh cream cheese, write date and initials. If you take the last jar, replace or note in the sheet.
anya: I'll make a 2-line sign for the fridge: "Label spreads. Clean crumbs. Replace last item." Short and printable.
ops-bot: Purchase request created: crumb brush + toaster sticker. Ticket #4389. ETA 3 days. (automated)
derek: Thanks all. Bagels for Monday incoming. Will bring a tiny jar of sesame seeds for communal topping. :bagel: 
anya: Legend. I'll make the sign and tape it by the toaster tomorrow at 9am."
